exposure: Fetal growth status (SGA, AGA, LGA based on customized percentiles)
Placental histological findings (inflammation, disruptive, obstructive, adaptive lesions)
cohort: The study included 150 singleton term stillbirths as cases, compared to control groups of 586 live births from low-risk pregnancies and 153 live births with late fetal growth restriction.
finding: Stillbirths at term showed higher rates of both small for gestational age (SGA) and large for gestational age (LGA) fetuses, and placental disruptive, obstructive, and adaptive lesions were significantly more common in stillbirths compared to low-risk live births.
birth_weight: Fetal weight classified as small for gestational age (<10th percentile), adequate for gestational age (10-90th percentile), or large for gestational age (>90th percentile) using customized standards, including a subset of very low birthweight (<=3rd percentile).
